title: Successor formula for iterated coupling
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\kappa$ be a probability law on $\Omega\times\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f,g:\Omega^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$. The iterated coupling expectation at length $n+1$ is the expectation over a pair $(a,b)$ with law $\kappa$ of the length-$n$ iterated coupling expectation applied to the functions $x\mapsto f(x,a)$ and $y\mapsto g(y,b)$.
